uncited: *   **Tree Topology:** Encoded using post-order Depth-First Search (DFS) ordering.
**Octree Construction:** Convert the input voxel grid into an octree.
**Node Encoding (Bottom-Up):** Recursively merge child features into parent features until the root is reached.
Lift channels from 64 to 128 using $\phi: R^{64 \times 4 \times 4 \times 4} \to R^{128 \times 4 \times 4 \times 4}$ (1x1x1 3D Conv).
Map channels back to 64 using $\psi$ (inverse of $\phi$).
**Node Classification (Testing Only):** Use a node classifier to label each node as empty, full, mixed, or interior.
**Node Decoding (Top-Down):** Recursively decode the root feature to leaf features.
